stories.title: Rawat seeks meet with Congress brass as Kumari Selja slams his yatra plan

en.title: Rawat seeks meet with Congress brass as Kumari Selja slams his yatra plan
en.summary: Harish Rawat's thanksgiving yatra has drawn criticism from Congress party leadership, with Kumari Selja opposing it as a parallel initiative harmful to party interests. A meeting between Rawat and party officials is scheduled for later in the week to address concerns about party unity.

stories.title: First international cargo vessel leaves eastern Assam since 1947

en.title: First international cargo vessel leaves eastern Assam since 1947
en.summary: An international cargo vessel has departed from Dibrugarh in eastern Assam, marking the first such departure since 1947. The historic movement reflects renewed activity at the port, once a major hub for river-based cargo operations.

stories.title: 19,000 West Bengal voters to miss bypolls as appeals remain pending in tribunals

en.title: 19,000 West Bengal voters to miss bypolls as appeals remain pending in tribunals
en.summary: Approximately 19,000 West Bengal voters may be unable to participate in upcoming bypolls due to pending appeals in electoral tribunals. The situation has arisen because three judges have resigned from the 19 Appellate Tribunals established by the Election Commission, leaving three positions vacant.

stories.title: Gyanesh Kumar changed Form 6 ‘illegally’ during SIR, says Rahul Gandhi

en.title: Gyanesh Kumar changed Form 6 'illegally' during SIR, says Rahul Gandhi
en.summary: Rahul Gandhi of the Opposition party has alleged that Gyanesh Kumar illegally modified Form 6 during an SIR process. The Opposition also contends that the Chief Election Commissioner acted unconstitutionally at the direction of senior government officials.

stories.title: For First Time, Pakistan To Deploy Troops To Aide Saudi-Backed Yemen Forces

en.title: For First Time, Pakistan To Deploy Troops To Aide Saudi-Backed Yemen Forces
en.summary: Representatives from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan met in Riyadh to discuss military cooperation. Pakistan will deploy troops to support Saudi-backed forces in Yemen.

en.title: Rawat defies warning by Congress brass, carries on Uttarakhand yatra
en.summary: A Congress official named Rawat continues with an Uttarakhand campaign despite warnings from party leadership.

en.title: Delhi Govt withholds current duty charge of Additional DCP given to officer accused of sexually harassing journalist
en.summary: The Delhi government has withheld an additional duty charge for a senior police officer facing sexual harassment allegations involving a journalist.

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi, Turkiye activate Mecca defence pact as Yemen war escalates

en.title: Pakistan, Saudi, Turkiye activate Mecca defence pact as Yemen war escalates
en.summary: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey have activated collective military cooperation measures following Houthi attacks in Yemen. The three nations agreed to enhance security coordination through the Mecca Defence Alliance.

stories.title: Bengaluru Jail Official Arrested For Allegedly Soliciting Sex From Convict's Wife

en.title: Bengaluru Jail Official Arrested For Allegedly Soliciting Sex From Convict's Wife
en.summary: A Bengaluru jail official has been arrested on allegations of soliciting sex from a convict's wife. Police are also investigating the official's potential role in facilitating the convict's release.

en.title: Prisons DIG allegedly sexually exploited convict's wife
en.summary: A Deputy Inspector General of Prisons has been accused of sexually exploiting the wife of a convict.

en.summary: Harish Rawat conducted a thanksgiving and public outreach tour on Monday, which subsequently prompted a warning from the Congress party.

en.title: 'Misleading': EC fact-checks Rahul Gandhi's 'CEC changed Form 6 illegally' post
en.summary: The Election Commission fact-checked a post by Rahul Gandhi about the Chief Election Commissioner allegedly changing Form 6 illegally, labeling the claim as misleading.

stories.title: Euro hits 17-month low as French debt fears, US inflation lift dollar

en.title: Euro hits 17-month low as French debt fears, US inflation lift dollar
en.summary: The euro fell to a 17-month low against the dollar as concerns about France's budget deficit and eurozone debt crisis mounted. US inflation signals simultaneously strengthened the dollar while bonds from heavily indebted countries faced selling pressure.

stories.title: PTC shares soar nearly 34% after Schneider Electric agrees to $22.6 billion buyout

en.title: PTC shares soar nearly 34% after Schneider Electric agrees to $22.6 billion buyout
en.summary: Schneider Electric agreed to acquire software company PTC for $22.6 billion in cash, with the board-approved deal representing a significant premium. The acquisition reflects industry consolidation driven by artificial intelligence disruption.

stories.title: US stocks: Nasdaq hits record as megacap gains offset elevated Treasury yields

en.title: US stocks: Nasdaq hits record as megacap gains offset elevated Treasury yields
en.summary: The Nasdaq Composite reached a historic high on Monday, driven by strong performance in large technology stocks including Nvidia, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, and Tesla. The S&P 500 also gained ground, though the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined slightly amid higher Treasury yields.

stories.title: Nykaa shares rise 4% as Q2 FY27 update points to strong growth across beauty, fashion

en.title: Nykaa shares rise 4% as Q2 FY27 update points to strong growth across beauty, fashion
en.summary: FSN E-Commerce Ventures, Nykaa's parent company, saw its share price increase following Q2 FY27 guidance indicating strong growth momentum, with consolidated GMV expected to grow in the high 20s and revenue metrics projected in the early to high 20s.

stories.title: Bajaj Finance shares jump 5% after Q2 business update. Why Jefferies sees 35% upside in its top pick?

en.title: Bajaj Finance shares jump 5% after Q2 business update. Why Jefferies sees 35% upside in its top pick?
en.summary: Bajaj Finance shares rose after reporting 26.5% year-on-year AUM growth in Q2 FY27 to approximately Rs 5.85 lakh crore. Jefferies maintained its Buy rating with a price target implying 35% upside potential.
